description: Every transitive first-order ZF model containing the ground model pointwise and the coded filter as an element contains the specified set of ground-name values, by internal name-evaluation recursion and its absoluteness. Together with the extension model theorem this makes that extension the least such model, including definable class models formula by formula. Full ZF model recursion and class-model satisfaction are unencoded, so this model-theoretic leastness assertion is unbound.
